request: After exposing a disk document directly in virtual memory on POSIX systems, omit the kernel hint that reads will proceed in order, so the kernel can choose its own read-ahead policy.

source.request: After exposing a disk document directly in virtual memory on POSIX systems, omit the kernel hint that reads will proceed in order, so the kernel can choose its own read-ahead policy.
source.settled: File-backed memory maps on Unix receive Advice::Sequential, with advice failures logged at debug level.
source.why: Omitting the access-pattern hint removes the sequential advice added to improve mapped-file search performance.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
